command:
sudo sh -c "cat > /usr/local/sbin/data-loop-setup <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
image=/var/lib/lvm-data/data-pv.img
loopdev=$(losetup -j \"$image\" | sed -n '1s/:.*//p')
if [ -z \"$loopdev\" ]; then
    loopdev=$(losetup --find --show \"$image\")
fi
lvmdevices --adddev \"$loopdev\" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
pvscan --cache \"$loopdev\" >/dev/null
vgchange -ay vg_data >/dev/null
EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/data-loop-setup
cat > /etc/systemd/system/data-loop.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop-backed physical volume for vg_data
RequiresMountsFor=/var/lib/lvm-data
Before=srv-data.mount

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/data-loop-setup
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
EOF
if ! grep -q '^[^#].*[[:space:]]/srv/data[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab; then
    printf '%s\n' '/dev/mapper/vg_data-lv_data /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=data-loop.service,x-systemd.after=data-loop.service 0 0' >> /etc/fstab
fi
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable data-loop.service
systemctl start data-loop.service
systemctl is-enabled data-loop.service
systemctl is-active data-loop.service
findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,SIZE,TARGET /srv/data
systemctl status srv-data.mount --no-pager -l | sed -n '1,12p'"
